items.title: グッチが新作バッグ「ジャッキー フラップ」発売、ショルダーとクロスボディの2way仕様
items.summary: Gucci released the Jackie Flap bag from the Gucci Primavera FW2026 collection, reinterpreting the iconic Jackie's piston-closure motif in a 2-way shoulder/crossbody design. Two versions offered: GG canvas (473,000 yen) and handcrafted leather (539,000 yen). Purely descriptive product announcement, no evaluative verdict from the outlet -- activation_coverage.

items.title: グッチが2way仕様の新作バッグ「ジャッキー フラップ」発売
items.summary: Yahoo Japan syndication of the Jackie Flap bag launch story, reaching a broader mainstream Japanese news audience beyond fashion-trade readers. Descriptive, non-evaluative -- activation_coverage.

items.title: グッチのアイコン「ジャッキー」着想のフラップバッグ、ヴィンテージ風レザーや"GGキャンバス"
items.summary: Additional Japanese fashion-trade coverage of the Jackie Flap launch, emphasizing vintage-style leather treatment and GG canvas craftsmanship. Descriptive activation coverage.

items.source: The Epoch Times (大紀元, Chinese edition)
items.title: 大陆奢侈品市场连两年收缩 Prada持续关店
items.summary: Mainland China's personal luxury goods market contracted for a second consecutive year (2024 down 18-20%, 2025 down another 3-5%). Reports Gucci has closed its Shanghai Huanhui iapm, Ruiou Department Store and New World Daimaru locations since last year, part of Kering's 84 global store closures in H1 2026 (about 40% in Asia). Clearly negative/critical framing on Gucci's China retail footprint.

items.title: 古驰在奢侈品行业处于什么地位？品牌价值138亿美元登顶意大利奢侈品牌第一
items.summary: Chinese financial-media piece citing the Kantar BrandZ 2026 report: Gucci's brand value at USD 13.8 billion, ranked first among Italian luxury brands and in the global top tier of luxury brand value. Neutral/factual industry-standing coverage.

items.title: Kering Shares Surge 15% on Gucci's Promising Turnaround Momentum
items.summary: Kering Q2 2026 revenue returned to growth for the first time in 12 quarters (H1 revenue EUR 7.2bn, +1% comparable); Gucci's organic sales fell only 2% (vs -8% in Q1), leather goods returned to growth on Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches, though mainland China remained the toughest market despite gradual improvement. Kering shares jumped roughly 15.9%, its strongest single-session gain in years. Independent, quantified third-party market reaction -- eligible for full positive magnitude per methodology (non-activation).

items.title: [2026 명품 트렌드] 명품의 핵심 소비국이 된 한국, 요즘은 가방보다 '주얼리'라고?
items.summary: Korean marketing-research blog (industry-community analysis format) reports Korean department stores saw jewelry/watch sales surge (Shinsegae jewelry +55.6%, watches +36.9%; Lotte and Hyundai high-jewelry/watch categories +55% and +55.1% YoY in Q1 2026) while spend patterns shift away from bags/RTW -- an indirect negative signal for Gucci's core leather-goods category even as overall department-store luxury demand holds up in Korea.
